mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, dept_id, is_primary, position, grant_time, status, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user, version, remark FROM user_dept WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}

SELECT id, user_id, dept_id, is_primary, position, grant_time, status, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user, version, remark FROM user_dept WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status IN (1, 2) ORDER BY is_primary DESC, grant_time ASC, id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE user_dept SET is_primary = 0 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status IN (1, 2) AND is_primary = 1
